title: arXiv preprint details WorldStream architecture and persistent world record
summary: An arXiv preprint specifies WorldStream's typed decision model, which decouples ahead-of-time corridor planning from just-in-time compilation and stores per-tile seed, boundary, and NPC state in a persistent world record.
research_notes:
Configure global generation seeds and environmental priors to initialize the Macro planning layer for regional ecology, hydrology, and transit networks.

Supply agent position and heading vectors to project the movement corridor, triggering ahead-of-time Micro planning for imminent spatial tiles.

Invoke local deterministic procedural compilation to translate approved Micro plan decisions into renderable 3D terrain, vegetation, and settlement assets.

Issue natural language commands to update runtime entities or tile attributes, persisting modified states to the per-tile world record database.

Decouple planning horizons from geometry compilation along predicted corridors to maintain stable frame rates and prevent compute spikes.

Enforce strict tile-to-tile boundary commitments in the Micro planner to avoid visual and topological seams between independently compiled cells.

Rely on re-compilation from per-tile seed and mutation records rather than caching high-poly meshes in memory when the agent traverses large distances.
